cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The alley's blocked. Excellent: our proposal picnic is harder to discover. Take the table by the other end.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have to use the main road. Everyone will see us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They'll see a house move. Keep the legs level; a casual removal looks more convincing than a secret procession.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming. I'll tell her to look away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Ask her to clear a path. No secretive instructions; she's helping with a house move.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 celebrates blocked access and directs table carrying. A3 corrects B2's exposure concern into casual-removal technique; A5 corrects B4's look-away plan into useful help, celebrating deeper camouflage.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 main-road constraint causes A3 house-move explanation. B4 girlfriend arrival and concealment suggestion cause A5 a new way to involve her without revealing the proposal.

relationship.evidence: B2 carries awkward furniture and B4 tries to protect the surprise. The helper's proposed solution becomes the next expression of A's game.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's threatening arrival into a more convincing ordinary move by assigning the recipient practical work, not an arbitrary extra obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1 proposal picnic/table and B4 girlfriend approaching provide the immediate logistics and romantic stakes. No new chairs or flowers are needed at the end.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's celebration, alternative request and brief no-secrecy instruction each guide what B should actually say to the girlfriend.

coach2.missing: The girlfriend need not actually comply for A's tactic to be understood.
coach2.firstDefect: No failed gate; this celebrates a new advantage rather than claiming the blockage was secretly planned.
